mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.tenant_id, m.user_id, m.status, m.joined_at, m.identity_tags, m.forbidden_domains, m.role_id, r.code AS role_code, r.name AS role_name, r.access_level, r.read_only_domains, m.gmt_create, m.gmt_modified, m.creator_id, m.modifier_id, m.is_deleted FROM org_member m LEFT JOIN workspace_role r ON r.id = m.role_id AND r.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_member (tenant_id, user_id, status, joined_at, access_level, role_id, identity_tags, creator_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{status}, NOW(3), #{accessLevel}, #{roleId}, #{identityTags}, #{creatorId}, 0)

INSERT INTO org_member (tenant_id, user_id, status, joined_at, access_level, role_id, identity_tags, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{status}, NOW(3), #{accessLevel}, #{roleId}, #{identityTags}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE joined_at = IF(is_deleted = 1 OR status != 0, NOW(3), joined_at), status = 0, access_level = #{accessLevel}, role_id = #{roleId}, identity_tags = #{identityTags}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, is_deleted = 0, gmt_modified = NOW(3)
mapper.select: WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY m.joined_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE org_member SET identity_tags = #{identityTags}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE org_member SET role_id = #{roleId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE org_member SET is_deleted = 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT m.tenant_id FROM org_member m INNER JOIN `org` o ON o.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status = 0 ORDER BY m.joined_at ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM org_member om1 JOIN workspace_role r1 ON r1.id = om1.role_id AND r1.tenant_id = om1.tenant_id AND r1.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om1.user_id = #{userId} AND r1.access_level = 'ADMIN' AND om1.is_deleted = 0 AND om1.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_member om2 JOIN workspace_role r2 ON r2.id = om2.role_id AND r2.tenant_id = om2.tenant_id AND r2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om2.tenant_id = om1.tenant_id AND om2.user_id != #{userId} AND r2.access_level = 'ADMIN' AND om2.is_deleted = 0 AND om2.status = 0 )
